items: 【Make Call & Message Notification】—Enjoy crystal-clear Bluetooth calls directly from your wrist and stay updated with real-time notifications from Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger. You can also enable 'Do Not Disturb' mode to silence alerts whenever you need focus. (Please note: Message replies are not supported.)

【1.85"AMOLED Display】—The Tensky smartwatch features a lightweight aluminum alloy body, seamlessly blending sophisticated style with rugged durability. Its vibrant 1.85" AMOLED touchscreen ensures all your data is easy to read, even under direct sunlight

【Accurate Health Monitoring】—Monitor your heart rate, SpO2, and menstrual health in real time. This women’s watch also provides an in-depth analysis of your sleep stages—including deep, light, and REM sleep. All data is seamlessly synced to the VeryFit app, empowering you to understand your patterns and cultivate healthier habits

【Reliable Fitness Partner】—Equipped with over 100 built-in sports modes, this fitness tracker precisely monitors key metrics including distance, calories, and steps. Whether you are cycling, running, or practicing yoga, its 3ATM water resistance makes it a reliable for swimming
【Long Battery Life】—With a 350mAh battery offering 5-10 days of uninterrupted use and a 2-hour fast charge, never worry about battery life again

【Wider Compatibility & 24/7 After-sales Support】—The smart watch is seamlessly compatible with both Android and iOS devices—simply connect to the VeryFit app to unlock its full range of features. We stand behind our quality with an 2-year war-ranty. Should you encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to our dedicated support team
